author: Lullshift
name: Reflection Prompts
description: Light, open questions shown one at a time. Install a prompt pack to fill it. Any notes you write stay on this device.

help.summary: A set of short prompts shown one at a time. The prompts come from a prompt pack.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Read a prompt, think about it, and move on whenever you like.
howToPlay: Read the prompt in front of you.
If the pack allows notes, you can type a few words in the box. This is optional.
Press Next for another prompt, or Back to return to the one before.
Press Clear my notes to erase everything you wrote in this pack.

controls.action: Previous or next prompt, when the prompt is focused
Move between the prompt, the notes box and the buttons

tips: Notes stay on this device, inside this pack's saved state. They are never sent anywhere and never shown on the paused view.
Skip any prompt that does not suit the moment.
